title: Right adjunct normalization for coefficient exchange
statement: Let ℓ be a prime, k a field of prime characteristic different from ℓ, E a finite coefficient subfield of Ω=PadicAlgCl(ℓ), and X,Y,X′,Y′ schemes separated of finite type over k. Let f:X→Y, g:Y′→Y, f′:X′→Y′, g′:X′→X be k-morphisms with sq:g′≫f=f′≫g. Write L_h^A,R_h^A and ε_h^A for the specified bounded constructible pullback, pushforward and counit for A=E or Ω (def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category). Write β_sq^A for its specified base-change map. Let T_Z:C_E(Z)→C_Ω(Z), α_h(V):T_T(L_h^E V)≅L_h^Ω(T_U V), and δ_h(K):T_U(R_h^E K)→R_h^Ω(T_T K) be exactly the coefficient functor and pull/push comparisons of def-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-comparisons, for h:T→U. No properness or Cartesianity is assumed. For every K∈C_E(X), define U_K=δ_f′(L_g′^E K) ≫ R_f′^Ω(α_g′(K).hom). Then L_f′^Ω(T_Y′(β_sq^E(K)) ≫ U_K) ≫ ε_f′^Ω(L_g′^Ω(T_X K)) = α_f′(L_g^E(R_f^E K)).inv ≫ T_X′(L_f′^E(β_sq^E(K)) ≫ ε_f′^E(L_g′^E K)) ≫ α_g′(K).hom.

proof.text: Prove the push-comparison counit formula by iterated mate/conjugate cancellation and the fully faithful restriction counit formula. The right normalization follows from counit naturality, this formula and naturality of the inverse coefficient pullback comparison. The complete argument is proved in Lean with no sorry.

theorem constructibleToQbar_exchange_right_adjunct
    (sq : CommSq g' f' f g) (K : PadicSubfieldConstructible X ℓ E) :
    (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ k f').map
      ((constructibleToPadicAlgCl Y' ℓ E).map
          ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k sq).app K) ≫
        constructibleToQbarTargetHom ℓ k E f' g' K) ≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
        (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ k f').counit.app
          ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ k g').obj
            ((constructibleToPadicAlgCl X ℓ E).obj K)) =
    (constructibleToQbarPullIso ℓ k E f'
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k g).obj
          ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k f).obj K))).inv ≫
      (constructibleToPadicAlgCl X' ℓ E).map
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k f').map
            ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange
              (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k sq).app K) ≫
          (boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
            (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k f').counit.app
              ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ k g').obj K)) ≫
      (constructibleToQbarPullIso ℓ k E g' K).hom
